# Where this code comes from

`net1d.py` is vendored from the ECGFounder release by PKUDigitalHealth
(https://github.com/PKUDigitalHealth/ECGFounder), whose MIT licence is in
`LICENSE` beside this file. It is kept byte-for-byte as published so the
architecture that loads the published weights is the authors' own.

That file is itself derived from `hsd1503/resnet1d`
(https://github.com/hsd1503/resnet1d), by Shenda Hong, which is licensed under
the Apache License 2.0. Its authorship is stated in the module docstring
("Shenda Hong, Mar 2020"). The Apache 2.0 terms therefore apply to that
upstream work in addition to the MIT grant above, and are reproduced in
`LICENSE.apache-2.0`.

Nothing in this directory is covered by the MIT licence at the root of this
repository.
